svg.text: Units: millimetres. General tolerance +/- 0.3 mm. Scale 1:1 (print at 100 percent, do not fit to page)
Sheet 4 of 6. Joshua Tree OS hardware, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Drawn from the CAD (nimbus_cad.py).
Section on the centre line (x = 0). Front shell in ink, back cover in terracotta. Walls 2.4. Half-lap at the reveal (0.5); the cover's lip (1.1 clearance 0.2) sits inside the shell.
Two M3 ribs and the Pi standoffs are off the centre line. The vent slot (96 x 3.2) is in the floor of the cover.
